candidates.title: FBI — Federal Bureau of Investigation
candidates.snippet: The FBI's mission demands organizational accountability. Public trust must be earned, and transparency is not optional—it is essential. To that end, the FBI Vault features a collection of documents and other media that have been processed under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). These files have been released either as proactive disclosures or as frequently requested FBI records.

candidates.snippet: Put simply, after the FBI conditioned social media companies to believe that the laptop was the product of a hack-and-dump operation, the Bureau stopped its information sharing, allowing social media companies to conclude that the New York Post story was Russian disinformation.
